commands.command: set -eu; echo BOOT_ID=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); echo KERNEL=$(uname -r); for p in /proc/device-tree/model /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model; do test ! -r $p || { echo -n MODEL=; tr -d '\000' <$p; echo; break; }; done; cat /sys/class/fpga_manager/fpga0/state; cat /proc/uptime
commands.name: identity

commands.command: set -u; lsmod | grep -E '^(fpgadrv|cnn_ddr_v10)' || true; for m in fpgadrv cnn_ddr_v10_candidate cnn_ddr_v10_p3_candidate cnn_ddr_v10_p3_dma_candidate; do if test -d /sys/module/$m; then echo MODULE=$m REF=$(cat /sys/module/$m/refcnt 2>/dev/null || echo NA) VERSION=$(cat /sys/module/$m/version 2>/dev/null || echo NA) SRCVERSION=$(cat /sys/module/$m/srcversion 2>/dev/null || echo NA); fi; done; ls -l /dev/fpgadrv0 /dev/network10_v10 /dev/network10_v10_p3 /dev/network10_v10_p3_dma 2>/dev/null || true; for d in /dev/fpgadrv0 /dev/network10_v10 /dev/network10_v10_p3 /dev/network10_v10_p3_dma; do test ! -e $d || { echo DEVICE=$d; fuser $d 2>/dev/null || true; }; done; find /sys/kernel/config/device-tree/overlays -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%f ' -exec sh -c 'cat "$1/status" 2>/dev/null || true' sh {} \; 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command: set -u; sha256sum /root/workspace/driver/fpgadrv.ko /run/media/mmcblk1p1/BOOT.BIN /run/media/mmcblk1p1/image.ub 2>&1; find /media/root/ESD-USB3/codex-fpga-backups -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'board-debug-kernel-20261004.tar' -exec stat -c 'RECOVERY %n bytes=%s mtime=%y' {} \; sha256sum /media/root/ESD-USB3/codex-fpga-backups/board-debug-kernel-20261004.tar 2>&1 || true
commands.name: factory-recovery

commands.command: set -u; K=/root/board-debug-kernel-20261004/linux-xlnx-xilinx-v2018.3; test -d $K && echo KERNEL_TREE_PRESENT=1 || echo KERNEL_TREE_PRESENT=0; if test -d $K; then echo TREE_KERNEL=$(make -s -C $K ARCH=arm64 kernelrelease 2>/dev/null); stat -c '%n bytes=%s' $K/Module.symvers $K/.config $K/scripts/mod/modpost 2>/dev/null; sha256sum $K/Module.symvers $K/.config $K/scripts/mod/modpost 2>/dev/null; fi
commands.name: kernel-tree

commands.command: set -u; df -Pk / /root/workspace /media/root/ESD-USB3 2>/dev/null; stat -f -c 'ROOT block=%S free=%f avail=%a free_inodes=%d' /; grep -E '^(MemAvailable|CmaTotal|CmaFree):' /proc/meminfo; ip -brief address show eth0; echo carrier=$(cat /sys/class/net/eth0/carrier) speed=$(cat /sys/class/net/eth0/speed) duplex=$(cat /sys/class/net/eth0/duplex); findmnt -rn -S /dev/sda1 -o SOURCE,TARGET,FSTYPE,OPTIONS || true; lsusb

commands.command: set -u; for n in buffer@0 buffer@1; do p=/sys/firmware/devicetree/base/reserved-memory/$n; echo NODE=$n; test -e $p/no-map && echo NO_MAP=1 || echo NO_MAP=0; od -An -v -tx1 $p/reg 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n'; echo; done; grep -E '^(00000000-3fffffff|840000000-87fffffff) : System RAM$' /proc/iomem || true
